title: Playing string bass, and shanghaiing Wingy Manone
summary: Brownlee swung the string bass until his leg stopped him; he tells how his band picked up Wingy Manone off Canal Street when Emmett Hardy was sick.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique
